tasks.instructions: Write the Marts transform collection and the four fact transforms in schema marts of the github Database: fct_pull_requests (one row per pull_request_number, is_open, hours_to_merge), fct_commits (one row per commit_sha), fct_pr_review_comments (one row per review_comment_id, left join stg_pull_requests for pr_author_login), fct_issues (one row per issue_number, is_open, hours_to_close). Read staging only, list every column, tag each with github_activity. Follow the build-clean-tables playbook.
